basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old digital nomad currently residing in Havana, Cuba. I recently discovered the world of Hololive and have been captivated by its charm and creativity. My interests include mobile technology, particularly FizzMobile's latest innovations, and exploring Cuban culture and history. I spend my free time diving into various music genres, with a particular fondness for Aesop Rock's lyrical genius. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to manage my schedule and indulge in my hobbies. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to travel and meet new people. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after my work commitments are done.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied visual arts in college. Over the years, I've honed my skills through online courses and hands-on experience working with clients from diverse industries. My interest in technology stems from a lifelong curiosity about gadgets and how they can enhance daily life. I've also developed a basic understanding of Cuban culture through immersive experiences while living there.
